reasoning_content:
Ruby 3.1.4 installed via RVM. Now install Node 20.11.0. Let's use fnm or nvm. fnm install script. Let me install node via fnm.

Actually, let me check if apt's nodejs available is too old. Use fnm.

action.command:
source /usr/local/rvm/scripts/rvm; ruby -v; gem -v; echo "---node---"
export FNM_DIR=/usr/local/fnm
curl -fsSL https://fnm.vercel.app/install | bash -s -- --install-dir /usr/local/fnm --skip-shell 2>&1 | tail -10
echo "EXIT:$?"; ls /usr/local/fnm 2>/dev/null

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "source /usr/local/rvm/scripts/rvm; ruby -v; gem -v; echo "---node---"
export FNM_DIR=/usr/local/fnm
curl -fsSL https://fnm.vercel.app/install | bash -s -- --install-dir /usr/local/fnm --skip-shell 2>&1 | tail -10
echo "EXIT:$?"; ls /usr/local/fnm 2>/dev/null", "security_risk": "HIGH", "summary": "Install fnm for Node"}
